purpose: Fail-closed closure of a human-rejected pending Shine Defence review candidate without creating certification state.
preconditions: Exactly one pending_review candidate exists for the supplied candidate id.
The canonical review checklist for that candidate exists and validates against the exact candidate and current canonical registry.
The checklist humanAuthorization status is rejected.
The rejected checklist contains an explicit human reviewer id, reviewedAt timestamp and summary.
At least one checklist requirement is not_satisfied.
The candidate does not already have a review decision record.
finalizationState: The candidate decisionReason is set to the exact human rejection summary from the canonical checklist.
Exactly one dismissed review decision is appended.
The decision authority equals the checklist reviewerId.
The decision decidedAt equals the checklist reviewedAt.
The decision summary equals the checklist human rejection summary.
The dismissed decision pins reviewChecklistBlobSha to the exact rejected checklist Git blob.
The dismissed decision pins reviewRegistryBlobSha to the rejected checklist registry identity.
atomicity: Candidate dismissal and the matching review decision are one repository state transition.
The helper is dry-run by default.
Apply mode writes only review-candidates-v1 and review-decisions-v1.
After writing, Defence validators run and any failure restores both files to their prior bytes.
Checklist fingerprint fields are derived from the already-validated canonical checklist; they are not supplied by the caller.
boundaries: Rejection finalization does not add or alter the reviewed ecosystem ledger.
Rejection finalization does not create, replace or delete a certification receipt.
Rejection finalization does not alter revocation state.
A dismissed candidate does not imply that the release is unsafe; it means only that this review closed without certification.
nonClaims: A checklist rejection is not automatically a candidate dismissal until this finalization completes.
The decision record is not certification authority.
The helper does not verify the real-world identity of the reviewer.
